Dear Base360.ai Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Founding Growth Marketer position, as I am deeply aligned with your vision of building the operating system for short-term rental businesses. My background as a digital marketer with a strong technical foundation, combined with extensive experience in SEO, content, web development, and AI-driven strategies, makes this role a compelling match.

I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to build a growth engine from the ground up, utilizing a data-driven approach to generate qualified leads and drive demo bookings. My daily use of LLMs for content, research, and automation, alongside my analytical skills in tracking performance, would directly contribute to your mission.

My CV provides further details on my experience. I am eager to discuss how my proactive and results-oriented approach can help Base360.ai reach its ambitious growth targets.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

cover_letter:
Dear Base360.ai Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Founding Growth Marketer position advertised for Base360.ai. Your mission to create an AI-powered operating system for short-term rental businesses, coupled with the entrepreneurial spirit of this role, resonates deeply with my professional aspirations and skill set. I am eager to contribute my blend of technical expertise and growth marketing acumen to your team from day one.

My career has been dedicated to transforming digital presence into measurable organic growth. At Episto and Knowledge Experts, I consistently applied on-page SEO, keyword research, and content strategies to elevate client websites, tracking performance with analytics tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. I thrive on identifying what works and scaling it, demonstrated by my work in optimizing sites like mirook.com, where technical SEO and GEO audits led to a measurably raised search-health score. This experience equips me to generate qualified leads and drive demo bookings for Base360.ai through diverse channels.

A key differentiator in my approach is the seamless integration of technology and marketing. I am an AI-savvy marketer, utilizing LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT daily for research, prompt engineering, and content automation, ensuring efficiency and an edge in a competitive landscape. My background in front-end development, including building and optimizing WordPress sites and developing features in AngularJS and JavaScript, directly translates to creating high-converting funnels and landing pages. This technical foundation, combined with a Google Ads Search Certification, allows for a holistic, hands-on approach to building and refining growth channels.

I am a resourceful and self-directed individual who prioritizes commercial results. My analytical mindset ensures that I track lead quality, conversion rates, and acquisition costs, turning data into actionable insights. The opportunity to work directly with the founder, experiment quickly, and shape the market entry of an innovative AI product is incredibly exciting. I am confident in my ability to take ownership, drive growth, and contribute significantly to Base360.ai’s success.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my experience and passion for building impactful growth engines can benefit Base360.ai.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• AI-driven digital marketer: Daily use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for research, content, audits, and prompt engineering, enhancing AI search visibility (AEO).
• SEO & Content expertise: Successfully implemented on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data (JSON-LD schema), and compelling content writing, consistently growing organic traffic for client websites.
• Proven analytical skills: Proficiently tracked and reported on performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to drive strategy and measure commercial results.
• Strong technical foundation: Experienced in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript, HTML, CSS), Python scripting for automation, and building/optimizing WordPress websites, including implementing llms.txt and knowledge-graph markup.
• Comprehensive marketing certifications: Certified in Google Ads Search, Content Marketing (HubSpot), GA4, and extensive SEO (Semrush Academy), demonstrating a broad and current understanding of key growth channels.
